svg.title: Figure 2 | Three independent environments on one computer
svg.desc: The projects manage packages in parallel to avoid interference. Stacking does not indicate execution order. Virtual environments do not provide file or network security isolation.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 2 | Three independent environments on one computer
Python 3.11 + a validated set of AI packages
Python 3.12 + another set of data-processing packages
The projects manage packages in parallel to avoid interference.
Stacking does not indicate execution order. Virtual environments do
not provide file or network security isolation.
